exposure: Genetic variants in estrogen-related genes (ESR1/2, CYP17A1/19A1, CYP1A2/1B1/3A4, and COMT)
cohort: The study included 249 patients with Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) and 1,237 controls.
finding: The study identified three novel pathogenic CYP17A1 missense mutations (p.Pro28Thr, p.Phe93Leu, and p.Arg347Leu) significantly associated with Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) and demonstrated reduced placental CYP17A1 expression.
